product_metadata.title: Masirs Collapsible Party Tray, 3 Tier, The Decorative Plastic Appetizer Trays Twist Down & Fold Inside, Minimal Storage Space, An Elegant Tray for Serving Sandwiches, Cake, Sliced Cheese and Deli Meat
features: REQUIRES MINIMAL STORAGE SPACE: The patented decorative trays twist down and nest in one another making it easy to store.
VARIETY OF USES: These plastic serving trays are great for holding sandwiches, cakes, muffins, fruits or whatever you’d like to serve.
GREAT FOR ANY OCCASION: Perfect appetizer tray to use at holiday dinners, family barbeques, office parties or any special event.
GREAT GIFT ITEM: This three tiered set of trays is a lovely gift idea for teachers,
STRONG AND DURABLE: These food trays are manufactured from ABS material, making them sturdy and reliable. U.S. Patent No. 9,433,311
description: This patented three tiered set of party trays is a fun and attractive way to serve guests at your next gathering. They are perfect for holding main food dishes such as sandwiches or bagels, sliced cheeses and deli meats. Alternatively, they’re an elegant way to present cut up fruits. Assorted cookies, cakes, muffins and pastries will also look lovely on these tiered trays. This set is suitable for any occasion. It’s ideal to use at home for family barbeques and holiday dinners. You’ll want to keep one at work too for business meetings and office parties. Best of all, you don’t need a large area to store this item. The trays twist down and nest inside each other, so the whole set takes up minimal storage space. When ready to use, simply twist to pop up and create your triple tower of serving trays. Manufactured from ABS material, these trays are strong, reliable and made to last. Elegant, yet simple and ideal for any occasion, this three tiered serving piece is a great gift item as well.
